summary.before:
What it measures. RAD51 is the protein that carries out homologous recombination repair. When repair is working, cells that have replicated their DNA show nuclear RAD51 foci after damage; when BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2 or another repair gene is lost, the foci do not form. The assay stains a routine formalin-fixed slide for RAD51 and geminin (a marker of the cells that should be repairing) and reports the share of geminin-positive cells with RAD51 foci. A low score is a functional read-out of homologous recombination deficiency at the moment of the biopsy.

Who should have it. It is being studied in the same settings as genomic HRD tests: high-grade serous ovarian cancer, triple-negative and BRCA-associated breast cancer, and metastatic prostate cancer, where the question is whether a PARP inhibitor or platinum will work. Unlike a genomic scar, which stays behind after resistance has developed, RAD51 foci return when repair is restored, so the assay may also identify patients whose tumours have become resistant.

Evidence. The Vall d'Hebron group showed that a RAD51 score measured in routine samples predicted PARP inhibitor response in patient-derived xenografts beyond BRCA mutation (EMBO Molecular Medicine 2018) and later linked low RAD51 to benefit from platinum in the GeparSixto breast cancer trial. Prospective trials selecting patients on RAD51 are ongoing. The assay is a research and academic laboratory test; no version has regulatory clearance as a companion diagnostic.

What changes. Today, nothing formally: treatment decisions still rest on BRCA sequencing and genomic scar scores. If validated, a low RAD51 score would widen PARP inhibitor use to tumours with no BRCA mutation and a negative scar score, and a high score after progression would argue against continuing them. Cost is that of an immunohistochemistry stain plus specialised scoring, and availability is limited to research centres.
summary.after:
RAD51 nuclear foci are assemblies of a protein involved in homologous recombination. Their interpretation depends on the sampled tumour cells, cell-cycle state, damage, staining, scoring and controls. A low count without enough informative cycling cells is uninformative rather than proof that repair is absent. The assay is a functional surrogate, not direct observation of every completed repair event.

Cruz and colleagues in 2018 assessed RAD51 with geminin as an S/G2 marker and gamma-H2AX as a damage marker in patient-derived breast cancer models and retrospective tumour specimens. Castroviejo-Bermejo and colleagues separately compared RAD51 and genomic HRD scores against olaparib response in breast cancer xenografts, then assessed feasibility in archival breast samples, including PALB2-related cancers. The latter clinical samples established feasibility, rather than a randomised benefit from choosing treatment with the assay.

A scar records accumulated genomic changes; a suitably controlled RAD51 result asks about a present repair-related state. Repair-restoring changes and acquired foci were observed in selected resistant BRCA-mutated breast cancers, but those small cohorts do not establish a universal treatment-switch rule. Use the actual assay version, informative-cell requirements and intended-use validation. A research score cannot replace the biomarker, disease and companion-test conditions of a medicine's label.

tldr.before: A microscope test on an ordinary tumour biopsy that counts RAD51 repair spots in dividing cells; few spots means the tumour cannot repair DNA by homologous recombination right now, which is what PARP inhibitors exploit.
tldr.after: RAD51 foci can inform a research assessment of current DNA repair when enough relevant tumour cells and appropriate damage and cycling controls are present.

before: PARP means poly(ADP-ribose) polymerase, a protein family involved in cellular signalling and repair. PARP1 is one representative. At damaged DNA it can build signals on proteins from chains of the chemical unit ADP-ribose, called poly(ADP-ribose), or PAR. Catalytic inhibition reduces this output. Some inhibitors can also stabilise DNA-associated PARP complexes, often called trapping. A repair-worker analogy separates a reduced call for help from a worker remaining in a doorway; proteins and medicines have no purpose, and the cell has more than one response route.

Murai 2012 compared niraparib, olaparib and veliparib in defined cellular and biochemical systems: niraparib and olaparib trapped PARP-DNA complexes more strongly than veliparib, despite catalytic inhibition being a different comparison. Murai 2014 compared BMN673, now talazoparib, with olaparib and rucaparib. In damaged-DNA cell assays, 0.1 micromolar BMN673 produced a trapping signal comparable to 10 micromolar olaparib, about a 100-fold concentration difference; the purified DNA-binding assay gave a different, roughly 40-fold comparison. Similar catalytic effects did not imply similar trapping. Strongest among compounds tested in 2014 is not a ranking of clinical benefit, tolerated exposure or personal treatment choices.

A DNA-associated protein obstacle can challenge copying without every encounter becoming a measured collision, double-strand break or cell death. Farmer 2005 demonstrated increased sensitivity to PARP inhibition in experimental BRCA-deficient systems. Cong 2021 studied single-stranded replication gaps in cellular models: gap suppression tracked resistance or resensitisation, while restoring fork protection did not always restore resistance in the tested models. Obstacle and gap explanations can coexist, but their relative contribution in a patient's tumour is not established by these experiments. A repair-gene variant alone does not reproduce the functional losses tested in a synthetic-lethal experiment.

Two schematic pictures ask different questions. Matched snapshots of DNA-bound PARP1 with a longer or shorter PAR chain illustrate catalytic output; a generic inhibitor in the catalytic pocket does not measure binding duration. A second picture places approaching copying machinery behind a retained PARP1 complex, with visible separation; it does not show an observed collision, literal backbone conformation or a measured effect size. Reduced catalytic activity and DNA retention can occur together. The arrows therefore lead to further context-dependent measurements, rather than two independent proofs of a clinical mechanism or a drug ranking.

Enzyme assays and PAR immunoassays report catalytic activity or its product. NCI's PAR assay measures PAR levels in specified biospecimens; chromatin-associated PARP measurements instead investigate DNA retention under specified conditions. Repair readouts and survival/regrowth experiments add other information. Murai's experiments used defined cell lines, DNA damage and drug concentrations, so neither a reduced metabolic or ATP signal alone nor a picture establishes irreversible death or its cause. Matched genetic perturbations and appropriate controls are needed to distinguish reduced growth, reduced metabolism and loss of long-term survival.

Waks's selected resistant breast cancer cohort illustrates why historical repair markers and current repair can diverge: four definite or putative BRCA reversion cases acquired RAD51 foci, and other proposed routes included 53BP1 loss and MRE11A amplification. The 53BP1-loss case lacked enough tissue for direct functional confirmation. A historical scar or sequence hypothesis cannot establish a present PARP vulnerability, and this small cohort does not supply an all-patient resistance rule. Biological plausibility, a qualifying label indication and a trial place are separate requirements.

For example, the U.S. olaparib label effective July 2025 specifies adjuvant treatment of adults with deleterious or suspected-deleterious germline BRCA-mutated, HER2-negative high-risk early breast cancer after neoadjuvant or adjuvant chemotherapy, selected with an approved companion diagnostic. A tumour-only BRCA result or high scar score cannot replace the germline and disease-setting requirements. That indication does not establish that a different PARP inhibitor, a different setting or a plausible mechanism has the same approval or access conditions.

In a fictional comparison, compounds A and B inhibit PARP catalytic activity similarly, but A retains more PARP on DNA in a culture assay. The conclusion is an assay-specific trapping difference. Useful exposure, survival, safety, resistance and clinical outcomes still need evidence. More trapping in that system does not establish a better treatment, and neither an old scar nor a repair-gene name identifies which effect matters in the current tumour.

Macroautophagy encloses cargo in a double-membrane autophagosome, delivers it through lysosomal fusion and degrades it for reuse. Formation, delivery and breakdown are separate steps; not all lysosomal processes use autophagosomes. Active recycling often supports stress adaptation, whereas autophagy-dependent death requires causal evidence implicating the machinery.

A completed macroautophagosome has separate inner and outer membranes, with space between them. When it fuses with a lysosome, the outer membrane joins the lysosomal boundary, while the inner membrane is degraded before enzymes gain access to the enclosed cargo. Itakura and colleagues located syntaxin 17 on completed autophagosomes, and Tsuboyama and colleagues found that loss of ATG conjugation systems markedly delayed inner-membrane degradation even when fusion occurred. A direct-fusion sketch omits intermediate endosomal interactions described in multicellular organisms; it is not the complete route taken by every compartment.

Product return has evidence in defined systems. In leucine-starved cultured human HEK-293T cells, Wyant and colleagues found that SLC38A9 was needed for leucine made by lysosomal protein breakdown to reach the cytosol; the response also depended on the autophagy protein ATG7. Abu-Remaileh and colleagues measured regulated lysosomal amino-acid exchange in mammalian cells. Yeast experiments identified Atg22, Avt3 and Avt4 as partially redundant vacuolar amino-acid exporters. These results support amino-acid recycling in those systems, without establishing transport of every breakdown product, secretion from the cell or guaranteed growth.

More lipidated LC3-II can reflect greater formation or slower removal. A controlled short lysosomal block and complementary tandem fluorescent LC3 reporter can help examine turnover and delivery to acidic compartments. Equal starting amounts can have different later fates. Little additional accumulation can reflect a late block, low formation or an unsuitable window; it does not establish dependence.

Flux, selected-cargo clearance and survival dependence are different claims. NBR1 experiments identify selective ubiquitinated-cargo handling, not a universal LC3 cargo census. Use time courses, viable-cell normalisation, verified lysosomal inhibition and independent perturbations; autophagy proteins can have other functions. Lower mTOR signalling can change initiation without guaranteeing completed degradation. Typical research outputs include normalised LC3-II band intensity, reporter compartments per cell and selected-cargo disappearance over time. Tested cultures are consumed or perturbed, and prolonged lysosomal inhibition can itself disturb the system. No universal LC3 or flux cutoff selects treatment.

A fictional one-hour recycling-station comparison starts with 20 waiting bags in each station. A receives 30 and processes 30, leaving 20; B receives five and processes none, leaving 25. summary.before: A tumour with thousands of mutations usually has two to eight drivers that confer a growth advantage; the rest are passengers that happened to be present in the cell that became cancerous. Drivers cluster in a few hundred genes: oncogenes activated by mutation or amplification (EGFR, KRAS, BRAF, HER2, ALK) and tumour suppressors lost by mutation or deletion (TP53, RB1, PTEN). Genomic profiling looks for known drivers because a tumour that depends on one can often be treated with a drug against it, the phenomenon called oncogene addiction.
summary.after:
A driver alteration contributes to cancer development in a specified biological context. Vogelstein and colleagues' 2013 review distinguished mutations conferring a selective growth advantage from passengers without that advantage. Calling a sequence change reliably does not establish which role it has, and a familiar gene can contain alterations with different or uncertain effects.

Contribution to cancer development, current survival dependence and clinical actionability are different claims. The SHIVA randomised study did not establish superior progression-free survival for its particular pathway-matching strategy in refractory advanced cancer; that result limits the tested strategy without invalidating every precision treatment. Specify the alteration, measured function, disease and treatment setting, intervention, comparator and outcome before concluding that a drug will help.

tldr.before: One of the few mutations in a tumour that actually causes it to grow. Everything else is a passenger along for the ride. Drivers are the mutations drugs are aimed at.
tldr.after: A driver alteration can promote tumour development in the context studied. That role does not by itself establish benefit from a drug.

before.name: Actionable genomic biomarkers
before.tldr: An actionable genomic finding has evidence relevant to a treatment decision in a specified setting. The exact alteration, cancer type and strength of treatment evidence matter.
before.summary: Biological function, contribution to cancer growth and evidence of treatment benefit are different claims. ESCAT ranks genomic targets by clinical evidence, distinguishing routine-use evidence from investigational, other-disease and preclinical findings. An abnormal functional assay does not establish drug benefit, and a gene-level match does not make every variant equivalent. Actionability should retain the alteration, disease, intervention and evidence tier. Trial eligibility, access and an individual's treatment decision require additional information.
notes: Clinical actionability connects a reliable finding to a specified decision in a particular cancer and treatment setting. A pathogenic variant, a cancer driver, target engagement, tumour response and longer survival are different claims. Ask whether actionable means worth studying, matched to a trial or supported for standard care; an evidence tier is not an individual response probability. Measurement reliability, clinical meaning and benefit from the resulting decision each need evidence.

The original 2018 ESCAT framework has six tiers: I, targets ready for routine clinical decisions; II, investigational targets with likely benefit requiring additional data; III, benefit in another tumour type or a similar target; IV, preclinical evidence; V, evidence for co-targeting approaches; and X, lack of evidence for actionability. Preserve any subtier and assessment date. Tier V does not endorse an arbitrary combination, and tier X describes the available evidence rather than proving that a target can never become useful.

The OncoKB therapeutic-level definitions distinguish level 1, an FDA-recognized biomarker for an approved drug in that indication; 2, a standard-care biomarker recommended by professional guidelines for an approved drug in that indication; 3A, compelling clinical evidence in that indication; 3B, standard-care or investigational evidence in another indication; and 4, compelling biological evidence. before.tldr: A functional assay tests what a genetic change does in a particular system. The result needs to fit the question about disease, and it does not automatically identify a useful treatment.
before.summary: ClinGen's primary recommendations for functional variant evidence evaluate disease mechanism, assay relevance, assay validation and the evidence for an individual variant. An abnormal assay result needs controls and evidence that the measured function is relevant to the disease mechanism. The PS3/BS3 framework concerns sequence-variant interpretation; it is not a cancer-drug actionability score. Treatment claims require evidence for the exact alteration, disease and intervention context.

appendNotes: A credible splice-site DNA change and a predicted splice consequence do not establish the same fact as measured abnormal RNA junctions. An observed RNA change still does not quantify intact protein or current repair function; an antibody signal needs its intended protein form and cell population specified. In a fictional case with an altered junction, reduced stain and an uninformative repair assay, those first two observations remain useful without completing the functional claim. For an uncharacterised receptor allele, a matched-expression comparison with the normal receptor can test activation in that system; absence of an extra phosphosignal there neither supports activation nor proves harmlessness in every context. Retain the exact variant, transcript, system, controls and remaining uncertainty rather than substituting the gene's reputation.

rows.before: بعد الغلوكوز، يُعدّ الغلوتامين الغذاء المفضّل للورم. فهو يغذّي دورة الطاقة، ويمنح النيتروجين لصنع حروف DNA، وينتج مضاد الأكسدة الغلوتاثيون. والسرطانات التي يحرّكها MYC وKRAS تستهلك منه كمية كبيرة إلى حدّ أنها تُجوّع الخلايا التائية المجاورة.
rows.after: يسهم الغلوتامين في عدة عمليات خلوية. ويجب اختبار اعتماد خلية بعينها على استقلابه في ظروف محددة.

rows.before: واحدة من الطفرات القليلة في الورم التي تسبب نموه فعلاً. وكل ما عداها طفرات راكبة ترافقه فقط. الطفرات المحرِّكة هي التي تستهدفها الأدوية.
rows.after: قد يسهم التغيّر المحرِّك في نشوء الورم ضمن السياق المدروس. ولا يثبت هذا الدور وحده أن دواءً ما سيحقق فائدة.

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2 هو مفتاح الدفاع المضاد للأكسدة في الخلية. كثيراً ما تعطّل سرطانات الرئة مفتاح الإيقاف (KEAP1)، فيبقى NRF2 مفعّلاً بشكل دائم، وهو ما يزيل سمية العلاج الكيميائي والإشعاع ويجعل هذه الأورام مقاومة لكل شيء تقريباً.
rows.after: ينظّم KEAP1-NRF2 دفاعات الخلية ضد الإجهاد. ويجب اختبار الحماية والاعتماد الأيضي والاستجابة للعلاج كلٌّ على حدة في نوع السرطان والظروف المعنية.

rows.before: Nach Glukose ist Glutamin die Lieblingsnahrung des Tumors. Es speist den Energiezyklus, liefert Stickstoff für den Bau der DNA-Buchstaben und bildet das Antioxidans Glutathion. MYC- und KRAS-getriebene Krebsarten verschlingen so viel davon, dass sie die benachbarten T-Zellen aushungern.
rows.after: Glutamin unterstützt mehrere Zellprozesse. Ob eine bestimmte Zelle von seinem Stoffwechsel abhängt, muss unter definierten Bedingungen geprüft werden.

rows.before: Eine der wenigen Mutationen in einem Tumor, die ihn tatsächlich wachsen lassen. Alles andere sind Passagiere, die nur mitfahren. Treibermutationen sind die Mutationen, auf die Medikamente zielen.
rows.after: Eine Treiberveränderung kann im untersuchten Zusammenhang die Tumorentwicklung fördern. Diese Rolle allein belegt keinen Nutzen eines Medikaments.

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2 ist der antioxidative Schutzschalter der Zelle. Lungenkrebs zerstört häufig den Ausschalter (KEAP1), sodass NRF2 dauerhaft eingeschaltet bleibt; das entgiftet Chemotherapie und Strahlung und macht diese Tumoren gegen fast alles resistent.
rows.after: KEAP1-NRF2 reguliert die zelluläre Stressabwehr. Schutzwirkung, Stoffwechselabhängigkeit und Therapieansprechen müssen für die jeweilige Krebsart und die jeweiligen Bedingungen getrennt geprüft werden.

rows.before: Después de la glucosa, la glutamina es el alimento favorito del tumor. Alimenta el ciclo energético, aporta nitrógeno para fabricar las letras del ADN y produce el antioxidante glutatión. Los cánceres impulsados por MYC y KRAS consumen tanta que dejan sin alimento a las células T vecinas.
rows.after: La glutamina participa en varios procesos celulares. La dependencia de una célula concreta de su metabolismo debe evaluarse en condiciones definidas.

rows.before: Una de las pocas mutaciones de un tumor que realmente hace que crezca. Todas las demás son pasajeras que van de acompañantes. Las mutaciones conductoras son las que los fármacos tienen como objetivo.
rows.after: Una alteración conductora puede favorecer el desarrollo tumoral en el contexto estudiado. Ese papel no demuestra por sí solo que un fármaco aporte beneficio.

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2 es el interruptor de defensa antioxidante de la célula. Los cánceres de pulmón a menudo rompen el interruptor de apagado (KEAP1), dejando NRF2 permanentemente encendido, lo que desintoxica la quimioterapia y la radiación y hace que estos tumores sean resistentes a casi todo.
rows.after: KEAP1-NRF2 regula las defensas celulares frente al estrés. La protección, la dependencia metabólica y la respuesta al tratamiento deben evaluarse por separado en el cáncer y las condiciones pertinentes.

rows.before: Après le glucose, la glutamine est l'aliment préféré de la tumeur. Elle alimente le cycle énergétique, fournit l'azote nécessaire à la fabrication des lettres de l'ADN et produit l'antioxydant glutathion. Les cancers pilotés par MYC et KRAS en consomment tellement qu'ils affament les cellules T voisines.
rows.after: La glutamine participe à plusieurs processus cellulaires. La dépendance d’une cellule particulière à son métabolisme doit être évaluée dans des conditions définies.

rows.before: L'une des rares mutations d'une tumeur qui la font réellement grossir. Toutes les autres sont des passagères qui suivent le mouvement. Les mutations conductrices sont celles que visent les médicaments.
rows.after: Une altération conductrice peut favoriser le développement tumoral dans le contexte étudié. Ce rôle ne démontre pas à lui seul le bénéfice d’un médicament.

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2 est l'interrupteur de défense antioxydante de la cellule. Les cancers du poumon cassent souvent le bouton d'arrêt (KEAP1), ce qui laisse NRF2 allumé en permanence ; celui-ci détoxifie la chimiothérapie et la radiothérapie et rend ces tumeurs résistantes à presque tout.
rows.after: KEAP1-NRF2 régule les défenses cellulaires contre le stress. La protection, la dépendance métabolique et la réponse au traitement doivent être évaluées séparément dans le cancer et les conditions concernés.

rows.before: ग्लूकोज़ के बाद ग्लूटामीन ट्यूमर का सबसे पसंदीदा भोजन है। यह ऊर्जा चक्र को चलाता है, DNA के अक्षर बनाने के लिए नाइट्रोजन देता है, और एंटीऑक्सीडेंट ग्लूटाथायोन बनाता है। MYC और KRAS से संचालित कैंसर इसे इतना अधिक खा जाते हैं कि पास की T कोशिकाएँ भूखी रह जाती हैं।
rows.after: ग्लूटामीन कोशिका की कई प्रक्रियाओं में काम आता है। कोई विशेष कोशिका इसके चयापचय पर निर्भर है या नहीं, इसे निश्चित परिस्थितियों में परखना ज़रूरी है।

rows.before: ट्यूमर की उन कुछ म्यूटेशनों में से एक जो सच में उसे बढ़ने का कारण बनती हैं। बाकी सब बस साथ चल रही यात्री म्यूटेशन हैं। ड्राइवर म्यूटेशन ही वे हैं जिन पर दवाओं का निशाना होता है।
rows.after: कोई ड्राइवर आनुवंशिक बदलाव अध्ययन की गई परिस्थितियों में ट्यूमर के विकास को बढ़ावा दे सकता है। यह भूमिका अपने आप किसी दवा के लाभ का प्रमाण नहीं है।

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2 कोशिका का एंटीऑक्सीडेंट रक्षा स्विच है। फेफड़ों के कैंसर अक्सर इसके बंद करने वाले स्विच (KEAP1) को तोड़ देते हैं, जिससे NRF2 स्थायी रूप से चालू रहता है, जो कीमोथेरेपी और विकिरण को निष्क्रिय कर देता है और इन ट्यूमरों को लगभग हर चीज़ के प्रति प्रतिरोधी बना देता है।
rows.after: KEAP1-NRF2 कोशिका की तनाव से बचाव की प्रणालियों को नियंत्रित करता है। बचाव, चयापचय पर निर्भरता और उपचार की प्रतिक्रिया को संबंधित कैंसर और परिस्थितियों में अलग-अलग परखना ज़रूरी है।

rows.before: ブドウ糖に次いで、グルタミンは腫瘍が最も好む栄養である。エネルギー回路を回し、DNAの文字を作るための窒素を供給し、抗酸化物質グルタチオンを作る。MYCやKRASによって駆動されるがんはグルタミンを大量に消費するため、隣にいるT細胞が飢えてしまう。
rows.after: グルタミンはさまざまな細胞過程を支える。特定の細胞がその代謝に依存しているかは、条件を明確にして検証する必要がある。

rows.before: 腫瘍にある変異のうち、実際に腫瘍を増殖させている少数の変異の一つである。それ以外はただ乗り合わせているだけの乗客変異である。ドライバー変異こそが薬の標的となる変異である。
rows.after: ドライバー変化は、研究された条件で腫瘍の発生を促すことがある。その役割だけでは、薬による利益は証明されない。

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2は細胞の抗酸化防御のスイッチである。肺がんではオフスイッチ（KEAP1）が壊れていることが多く、NRF2が常にオンのままとなり、化学療法や放射線を解毒してしまうため、これらの腫瘍はほぼすべての治療に抵抗性を示す。
rows.after: KEAP1-NRF2は細胞のストレス防御を調節する。防御作用、代謝への依存性、治療への反応は、該当するがんと条件ごとに分けて検証する必要がある。

rows.before: Depois da glicose, a glutamina é o alimento favorito do tumor. Ela abastece o ciclo de energia, fornece nitrogênio para fabricar as letras do DNA e produz o antioxidante glutationa. Os cânceres impulsionados por MYC e KRAS consomem tanta glutamina que deixam as células T vizinhas sem alimento.
rows.after: A glutamina participa em vários processos celulares. A dependência de uma célula específica do seu metabolismo deve ser testada em condições definidas.

rows.before: Uma das poucas mutações de um tumor que realmente o fazem crescer. Todas as outras são passageiras, apenas acompanhando. As mutações condutoras são as que os medicamentos têm como alvo.
rows.after: Uma alteração condutora pode promover o desenvolvimento tumoral no contexto estudado. Esse papel não demonstra, por si só, benefício de um medicamento.

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2 é o interruptor de defesa antioxidante da célula. Os cancros do pulmão quebram frequentemente o interruptor de desligar (KEAP1), deixando o NRF2 permanentemente ligado, o que desintoxica a quimioterapia e a radiação e torna estes tumores resistentes a quase tudo.
rows.after: KEAP1-NRF2 regula as defesas celulares contra o stress. A proteção, a dependência metabólica e a resposta ao tratamento exigem avaliações separadas no cancro e nas condições relevantes.

rows.before: 在葡萄糖之后，谷氨酰胺是肿瘤最喜爱的食物。它为能量循环供能，为合成DNA字母提供氮，并生成抗氧化剂谷胱甘肽。由MYC和KRAS驱动的癌症吃掉的谷氨酰胺太多，以至于让旁边的T细胞挨饿。
rows.after: 谷氨酰胺参与多种细胞过程。特定细胞是否依赖其代谢，需要在明确的条件下检验。

rows.before: 肿瘤中真正导致其生长的少数突变之一。其余的都是搭便车的乘客突变。驱动突变正是药物所针对的目标。
rows.after: 驱动性改变可以在所研究的背景下促进肿瘤发生。这种作用本身并不能证明某种药物会带来益处。

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2是细胞的抗氧化防御开关。肺癌常常破坏其关闭开关（KEAP1），使NRF2持续处于开启状态，从而对化疗和放疗进行解毒，使这些肿瘤几乎对所有治疗都产生耐药。
rows.after: KEAP1-NRF2调控细胞的应激防御。保护作用、代谢依赖和治疗反应需要在相应癌症和实验条件下分别检验。

rows.before: 在普通肿瘤活检切片上用显微镜计数分裂细胞中的 RAD51 修复斑点：斑点很少，说明肿瘤此刻无法通过同源重组修复 DNA，而这正是 PARP 抑制剂所利用的弱点。
rows.after: RAD51修复斑点可为评估当前的DNA修复功能提供研究证据，但必须有足够的相关肿瘤细胞，并具备合适的损伤和细胞周期对照。

rows.before: KEAP1-NRF2 is the cell's antioxidant defence switch; some lung cancers break the off-switch so it stays on, detoxifying chemotherapy and radiation and resisting almost everything.
rows.after: These proteins help control how a cell handles stress. Test what the defence does and whether the cells depend on it; the gene names alone do not show which treatment will help.

rows.before: After glucose, glutamine is the tumour's favourite food, feeding energy and DNA building; MYC- and KRAS-driven cancers eat so much of it that they starve nearby T cells.
rows.after: Some cells use glutamine for growth and other work. Experiments must test whether a particular cell needs a specific glutamine-processing route.

rows.before: A driver mutation is one of the few changes in a tumour that actually makes it grow, unlike passenger mutations, and drivers are what targeted drugs aim at.
rows.after: Some DNA changes help a cancer develop. Finding such a change does not by itself show that a drug will help.

rows.before: The RAD51 foci assay counts DNA repair spots in dividing cells on an ordinary biopsy, and few spots means the tumour cannot repair DNA in the way PARP inhibitors exploit.
rows.after: This test looks for repair-protein spots in tumour cells. Few spots are informative only if enough suitable cells and proper controls were present.
